exclude_selectors drops entire subtree unlike strip_tags which keeps children

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<body><div class="wrapper"><p>Inner paragraph</p></div><p>Outer text</p></body>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"exclude_selectors":[".wrapper"]}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone()));
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
